purpose: First closed GyroFlight roll autotune loop in the AIR65 Betaflight lockstep SITL. Simulator only: no flight controller, no Blackbox flight, no P45 trial.

environment.note: Betaflight 2026.6.2-lineage lockstep SITL (fork commit 32c557935) runs gyro filtering and the PID loop at 1 kHz; VisFly plant whoop_65mm_v1 (approximated AIR65 mass/inertia, motor tau 12 ms, no gyro noise). Base configuration = oracle recipe v1 + the AIR65 19 Oct tune overlay v2; only roll P/I/D and d_max_roll are replaced.

calibration.note: Measured before registration, current AIR65 tune and three box corners only, on a calibration doublet (+350/-350 deg/s, 100 ms each) that is in neither manoeuvre set.
calibration.repeatBitIdentical: 2 of 3 repeats; the third differs by one 0.1 deg/s LSB on 107 samples, together with the RC-smoothing RX-rate header estimate (110 vs 109)

metrics.tracking: per manoeuvre RMS(gyro - setpoint) / RMS(setpoint) over its window; set value = mean over manoeuvres
metrics.overshoot: per edge of the logged setpoint: max excess beyond the new value in the step direction / step size; per manoeuvre the max over edges; set value = mean over manoeuvres
metrics.riseMs: per edge: ms until the gyro first reaches 90 % of the step (segment length if never); mean over all edges and manoeuvres
metrics.oscillation: per edge: peak-to-peak error from settleDelayMs after the edge to the next edge / step size; max over everything
metrics.saturationShare: share of window samples with any motor >= motorHigh or <= motorLow; max over manoeuvres

improvement: A tune is better than a reference when: oscillation <= oscillationMax and saturationShare <= saturationShareMax (absolute rejections), cost <= reference cost * (1 - minRelativeGain), tracking <= reference * (1 + trackingTolerance), overshoot <= reference + overshootToleranceAbs, riseMs <= reference * (1 + riseTolerance) + riseToleranceMs. minRelativeGain 0.02 is > 300x the measured repeat spread.

search.dMaxNote: d_max_roll = round(d * 4/3), the AIR65 ratio 30/40, so D moves the whole D range (in this firmware d_max <= D disables the boost).
search.order: Round candidates around the incumbent in the fixed order P up, P down, D up, D down, I up, I down (rounded to integers, clamped to the box, duplicates and already-measured tunes skipped). A round is measured completely (within the budget); the lowest-cost candidate that is better than the incumbent and also better than the start tune (so per-step tolerances cannot add up) becomes the incumbent (ties: the earlier one). The same factor repeats while a round improves; then the next factor. Search ends when the budget is used or no factor improves.

holdout: After the search, start tune and selection are both measured again holdoutRepeats times on the held-out manoeuvres in the same invocation; the means are compared with the same improvement rule. The selection is kept only if it is better than the start there; otherwise the start tune is kept. No re-selection after the holdout.

validity.harness: status harness_error (provisioning, startup, SITL I/O, run short), a header that does not carry exactly the requested roll PID and d_max, any other header line different from the run's first measurement (except the run-time keys vbatref, rc_smoothing_active_cutoffs_ff_sp_thr, rc_smoothing_rx_smoothed), no high-resolution log, looptime != 1000, or a logged setpoint that does not equal the schedule at a constant delay of 0-2 ticks. Says nothing about the candidate: one retry for harness_error, otherwise the start tune's run stops as BLOCKED.
validity.candidate: plant roll angle beyond maxAbsRollDeg, height below minZ or non-finite plant state = the candidate failed the manoeuvre (rejected, not a harness fault).
validity.harnessAmendment_v1_1: A logged setpoint that does not follow the schedule is a harness fault (one retry, like harness_error) only when the adapter's commandPhaseSlips list a later command-activation gap other than 10 PID ticks that explains it; an unexplained mismatch stays non-retryable (BLOCKED).

startTunes.rationale: The AIR65 tune flown since 19 Oct 2026.
The VliegAI oracle recipe's roll PID: a soft tune at the lower edge of the box.
High P with little D: expected to overshoot and ring.
Low P with a lot of D: expected to be slow and damped.

success: The demo shows GyroFlight's loop working if, from at least two start tunes, the selection is better than the start tune on the held-out manoeuvres (decision 'improved'). Every start tune is reported, also when it is kept.

reRegistrations.changed: retry classification only: a setpoint mismatch explained by a logged command phase slip is a harness fault (one retry)
reRegistrations.unchanged: thresholds, box, budget, step factors, candidate order, manoeuvres, start tunes, holdout rule, success criterion
reRegistrations.reason: demo1 run 051 (T4 candidate 35,79,75): command 57 became active 11 PID ticks after command 56 instead of 10, so the logged setpoint moved one sample later from there; under v1 this stopped T4 as BLOCKED. A slip says nothing about the candidate.
reRegistrations.scope: T4 is re-run alone; T1-T3 keep their v1 result (their runs had no slip in the scored setpoint; the only other slip, run 049 of T4, fell in settle zeros).
reRegistrations.verdict: The v1 result stands as the registered outcome; the T4 re-run is reported separately.
